title: Contract: Mol
summary: Take Mol’s contract from the House of Hope and show it to her in the Guildhall.

fields.Access: Pass DC 10 Wisdom on the Inert Infernal Gem, then DC 20 Arcana on the Infernal Control Gem. Each party member normally has one attempt at each check.
fields.Use: Show the contract to Mol in the Guildhall. The item’s Use command itself has no effect.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
